governance.attested_by: neiso-43 closeout 2026-07-01 (neiso-41 full recipe + ISO-NE scarcity-price overlay)
governance.note: neiso-43 = the neiso-41 keeper recipe (measured Algonquin/EIA-MA-citygate DAILY gas-hub basis overlay + dual-fuel oil re-attribution + EIA-930-pinned hydro budget with 2024 plant-capacity backfill + biomass/OTHER measured must-run + historic CAMPD outage overlay + the dual-limb temperature-correlated reliability floor + floor-class outage exemption) PLUS the post-solve ORDC scarcity-price overlay with ISO-NE-grounded parameters (VOLL $2000 = ISO-NE Tariff III.1.10.1A offer cap, MCL 1200 MW ~ Millstone 3 largest single contingency, sigma 900 MW = ISO-NE PAF Study 2022). The overlay computes a reserve-shortage adder from solved headroom and adds it to econ_prices for capacity economics; dispatch/volumes/emissions untouched. Every lever anchors to a measured physical input or market-design parameter; no adder/haircut/sigmoid is tuned to a price error or volume residual; the LP is not pinned to observed CEMS generation or any measured outcome; outage availability derives from historic CAMPD unit-level forced-outage windows (exogenous to net-load calibration).
governance.validation_note: Reproducible from the committed bundle: scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso NEISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --commitment --reliability-floor --hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly --gas-hub-basis-daily --scarcity-price-overlay --out-dir results/calibration/neiso_closeout. The reliability floor fires via the generic RELIABILITY_FLOOR_REGISTRY with 3 enabled limbs (Boston:CT_PEAKER:tmax, Central:CC_REGULAR:tmax, Connecticut:CT_PEAKER:tmax). ORDC params applied at runtime via NEISO default_scenario_overrides (ordc_voll=2000, ordc_mcl_mw=1200, ordc_lolp_sigma_mw=900, ordc_lolp_shift_sigma=0, ordc_multistep_floor=false). Floor-class outage exemption (COAL, ST_GAS) is automatic in fleet.py when reliability_floor=True and iso=NEISO.

exceptions.magnitude: model 51.61 vs deflated EIA-930 grid actual 50.63 TWh (+0.98 TWh, +0.7pp); gas FAMILY 53.39 vs 52.75 (+1.2%, within the C2 +/-2.5% band)
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (gas-vs-EIA-930-OTHER fold-in categorization, not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: The gas FAMILY is within tolerance (C2 PASS, +1.2%); the per-class C1 gate flags CC_REGULAR because the small family-level surplus concentrates in the marginal combined-cycle unit AND the per-class actual is deflated by the geothermal+biomass that NEISO folds into the EIA-930 'Natural Gas' cell. Closable only by reconciling the OTHER/NG-fold-in categorization on both sides, NEVER by injecting the residual or scaling CC to the deflated benchmark.

exceptions.magnitude: model 56.13 vs deflated EIA-930 grid actual 54.66 TWh (+1.47 TWh, +1.2pp); gas FAMILY 57.89 vs 56.91 (+1.7%, within the C2 +/-2.5% band)
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (gas-vs-EIA-930-OTHER fold-in categorization, not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: Same gas-vs-EIA-930 fold-in categorization as 2023: gas family within C2 band (+1.7%), per-class CC_REGULAR deflated by ~1.6 TWh of geothermal+biomass folded into the NG cell. Not a dispatch error; closable only by reconciling categorization.

exceptions.metric: C1 coal + steam-gas grid-delivered energy under-run (winter reliability/fuel-security runner)
exceptions.magnitude: COAL_BIT model 0.058/0.113/0.234 vs actual 0.181/0.238/0.271 TWh (2023/24/25); each per-class miss is WITHIN the C1 per-class absolute band
exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (structural; same winter fuel-inventory / reliability-commitment family as the C3c price-tail and C5b storage items)
exceptions.reason: Residual under-run after the availability fix: the energy-only LP runs coal only at the temperature-floor commitment plus the few hours delivered gas is dear enough. The REAL units ran more on a winter fuel-security / local-reliability commitment. Closable only via the documented future build (fuel-inventory / seasonal-reliability constraint), NEVER by cranking the floor slope/cap or by an offer adder.

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (winter fuel-inventory scarcity rent / reserve scarcity)
exceptions.reason: The energy-only LP caps the cold-hour price at the dual-fuel oil-parity (~$258/MWh). The post-solve ORDC scarcity overlay (ISO-NE-grounded LOLP curve: VOLL $2000, MCL 1200 MW, sigma 900 MW) is the structurally-correct lever: it prices the reserve tightness the perfect-foresight LP misses. The overlay fires in this run (scarcity_price_overlay=True) and modifies econ_prices for capacity economics but does not change the persisted LP prices. The overlay params are grounded in ISO-NE's largest contingency (Millstone 3) and winter reserve uncertainty (PAF Study), NOT fitted to hit the 15h target.

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (winter fuel-inventory scarcity rent / reserve scarcity)
exceptions.reason: Same structural item as 2023. Post-solve ORDC overlay fires and modifies econ_prices.

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (winter fuel-inventory scarcity rent / reserve scarcity)
exceptions.reason: Same structural item as 2023/2024. Post-solve ORDC overlay fires and modifies econ_prices.

exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (downstream of the price_tail / reserve-scarcity item)
exceptions.reason: Storage arbitrage throughput tracks the peak-to-trough price spread, which is compressed because the LP caps the cold-hour tail at the dual-fuel oil-parity. Closes only when the winter fuel-inventory scarcity rent is recovered.

exceptions.metric: C2 gas family grid-delivered TWh (preliminary 2025 vintage)
exceptions.magnitude: model 61.41 vs corrected EIA-930 59.76 TWh (+2.8%, outside +/-2.5% band)
exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (EIA-930 gas-vs-OTHER fold-in + preliminary-vintage incompleteness)
exceptions.reason: 2025 is a preliminary EIA-923 vintage — per-class actuals are incomplete (EIA-923 reports only 52.36 TWh gas vs model 61.41 TWh). The scorer falls back to the EIA-930 grid gas cell, which INCLUDES geothermal+biomass (~5.2 TWh). The correction formula (subtract cf[OTHER]+cf[biomass]-e930[other]) under-corrects because the preliminary vintage's per-class cells are incomplete. This is the SAME categorization issue documented in the C1 CC_REGULAR exceptions (gas FAMILY within band for complete vintages 2023/2024). When the full 2025 vintage reconciles, the per-class gate replaces this family fallback. NOT closable by adjusting model dispatch.

exceptions.metric: C5c monthly storage dispatch shape (pearson r)
exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (downstream of the price_tail / reserve-scarcity item)
exceptions.reason: Monthly storage dispatch shape is driven by the monthly pattern of price spreads. The LP's structural missing scarcity rent compresses winter price peaks (the same root cause as C3c price-tail and C5b storage throughput), which distorts the seasonal pattern of storage arbitrage. Closes only when the winter fuel-inventory scarcity rent is recovered — the ORDC overlay modifies econ_prices for capacity economics but does not change the LP dispatch that drives the monthly shape.
